periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique orientation, tilted approximately 45 degrees downward toward the snout relative to the horizontal facial axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval, with the longitudinal axis significantly greater than the transverse width.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Pronounced downward tapering at the ventral-medial margin of the patch, extending below the geometric center.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow U-shaped curvature along the posterior margin of the transverse band across the spine.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: The band is relatively thick, occupying approximately 30 percent of the visible dorsal surface area.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Significant separation between the ears, roughly 1.5 times the width of a single pinna.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Uniformly rounded and convex at the superior margins.

other_distinctive_markers: A thin, straight wooden stalk diagonally intersects the frame, occluding the cranial region and the area above the right eye patch.
